candidates.title: Cross-domain action primitives
candidates.oneSentence: Real-world action must begin from independently addressable, fact-bound direction, perspective, and authority, and return as independently replayable causal experience.
candidates.claimBoundary: This candidate was promoted to numbered draft KFD-7. Promotion allocates KFD-7 and publishes a draft reference contract; it does not activate a universal product Profile, turn Fact or Episode into a domain-Primitive claim, require named physical stores, establish universal necessity, or allocate the non-binding slot hints of its elaboration candidates.

candidates.title: Atlas action perspective
candidates.oneSentence: Every consequential action must bind to an addressable perspective and fact cut.
candidates.claimBoundary: This candidate does not allocate KFD-8, require the name Atlas, mandate one serialization or product surface, claim perspective completeness, or create a normative organization decision.

candidates.title: Pursuit intent continuity
candidates.oneSentence: Intent that survives an action must have an identity independent of the action that advances it.
candidates.claimBoundary: This candidate does not allocate KFD-9, require the name Pursuit, mandate one decomposition shape or workflow, establish universal necessity, or create a normative organization decision.

candidates.title: Warrant bounded authority
candidates.oneSentence: Permission to act must remain explicit, bounded, derivable, and independently revocable.
candidates.claimBoundary: This candidate does not allocate KFD-10, require the name Warrant, replace domain authorization systems, establish universal necessity, or create a normative organization decision.
